name: 60031 · Gurnee, IL
findings: ZIP 60031 (Gurnee) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60031 (Gurnee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
